subject.title: [Bug] v2026.6.11 published dist missing reentrancy guard - reply session initialization conflicted

question: Should release managers publish a stable hotfix/repack for the affected v2026.6.11 npm package now, or wait for the next stable train?
rationale: Current main fixes the source path, but latest stable users are still on a published package whose dist lacks the fix; choosing a stable hotfix versus waiting is a release ownership decision, not an autonomous source repair.

options.title: Publish stable hotfix
options.body: Cut a new stable package from the fixed source and attach npm tarball parity plus channel delivery proof before closing this issue.

options.title: Wait for next stable
options.body: Keep this issue open and clearly document v2026.6.11 as affected until the next stable release ships with the corrected dist.

recommendation.title: Publish stable hotfix
recommendation.body: Cut a new stable package from the fixed source and attach npm tarball parity plus channel delivery proof before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS assigns the npm release workflow and release checks to this release owner team, and the remaining action is package publication.
